meta.title: Studio
meta.description: The design studio's page: a brief composer placeholder and the works library of delivered designs. A delivered design is registered automatically, and each work shows its type, theme and file path in a thumbnail grid. Drafting from the page is not ready yet; for now, ask in chat. Everything is kept locally under the profile's studio directory.
